## Observations

- Runs: five full runs during development (assertions changed between runs 1-4 and 5); final run 56/56. Retries seen before the final run: S2 (model declined `rm -rf src` until the prompt said it was a disposable fixture and approval is the human's call), S3 (first prompt let the model skip the refused-edit path), S8 (an earlier assertion treated an approved re-run as a duplicate). All were model/assertion issues, not runtime faults.
- Event order: `run.tool.running` is emitted BEFORE the guard parks the call, so every approved call shows `running -> waiting -> started(new attempt) -> running -> succeeded`. A first `running` therefore does not mean the tool executed; assertions use the terminal event (`run.tool.succeeded`) instead. A client that renders `running` from the event log shows a parked call as running.
- Guard refusals: the model-facing tool record carries `errorCode: tool_guard_refused` with the plan-mode hint, but the `run.tool.failed` event carries the generic `tool_failed`. Same for `approval_denied` (tool record only; the denied call gets no terminal `run.tool.*` event at all). The record is the durable source of the specific code.
- Plan mode (S3): the model asked for `full_auto`; the host granted `auto_edit` (policy), `grantedPlan` recorded, edits and tests then needed per-call approvals. The model's request was recorded, not obeyed.
- Stale answers (S4): second approve with a new answerId -> `AnswerConflictError/answer_conflict`; same answerId replay -> idempotent `duplicate:true`; approve after cancel -> `AnswerStaleError/answer_stale`; export shows answered/cancelled.
- Role ceilings (S5): reviewer and supervisor never see the forbidden tools (`profile_tools_pruned` names them); the `role_ceiling` guard path itself is not reachable from a live model because pruned tools cannot be called. It stays covered only by the offline suite.
- Network (S6): curl exits 6 (could not resolve host) inside the sandbox; no page content returned.
- Interrupt (S7/S8): interrupted turns park `interrupted` with no `run.cancelled`/`run.failed`; resume gives attemptCount 2 with contiguous seq. In S8 the interrupted `run_tests` call ends with NO tool record and no terminal event (`(none: missing)`), and was never re-executed under its id. When a model re-requests `run_tests` under a new id, the uncertain-side-effect guard parks it for approval even in `full_auto` (seen in earlier S8 runs); a different tool (e.g. `run_command`) was not gated. Whether the model is told the first result is uncertain was not verified here (provider requests were not captured).
- Model: steady with explicit tool instructions; reasoning-heavy turns (hundreds of delta events) are common, latency per scenario 2-14s.
